items: 48V split-phase 120/240V inverter/charger (grid-charge backup) or 48V hybrid solar inverter
DC fuse/breaker, disconnect and battery cables sized for the inverter
why: In both chats ChatGPT says the DIY system is a 51.2V LiFePO4 battery plus a compatible inverter/charger plus DC protection. It also asks whether the shopper wants solar charging, which forks the set between a grid-charged 6000W 48V inverter/charger and a SPH6548P hybrid inverter (or the SGR-8K10E complete kit) with panels. The battery voltage has to match the inverter's 48V DC input, the system needs split-phase 120/240V output, and the DC fusing has to be rated for the inverter's current, so a shopper who guesses can easily buy parts that don't work together, and ChatGPT showed no product card for any of these sets.
